provenance.prediction_query: all actual rows, separate populations and arms

adaptation: Scoped upstream model factory pins TabPFN 2.5 and random_state. Upstream S-learner fits all 6,000 training rows per nonempty coalition. Predict all actual training and held-out rows separately, then aggregate within each of 16 binary states. Explicit float32 inference; no query compression.
endpoint: Full-set CATE anchor reuses the full S-learner, so full residual is zero by construction; upstream can have a nonzero endpoint with an independently estimated CATE anchor.
uncertainty: Five splits of one frozen dataset, not confidence intervals or independent DGP replications.
finite_sample_target: Training crude contrast minus evaluation-standardized adjusted contrast includes nuisance error and population-composition variation, not solely true confounding.
limitations: No renal oracle for confounding allocation; DGP ATE reference only.
Conditional mean-absolute prediction/CATE SHAP have different targets from signed bias attribution.
No full replication of the paper benchmark; one estimator, version-pinned adaptation.
